# Request changes: comments go to the fixer, with a fresh fix budget

## What to build

The heart of the human review round (spec `docs/prd/06-human-review-round.md` §6, §7.4). While the run waits for review, **Request changes** sends the open comments through the normal loop:

1. `POST /review/changes` (409 if there is no open comment) → `RetryHub.decide({ review: "changes" })`.
2. The review phase turns every open comment (status `open` or `reopened`, any round) into a **blocker** finding `human-<comment id>` and starts a fix pass with a **fresh `fixPasses` budget**: fixer → validation gate → code reviewer + live tester, repeating up to `fixPasses` passes as usual.
3. The fixer prompt gets a `## Human review comments (fix all of them)` section **before** the other findings.
4. When the loop ends (clean or exhausted), the run pauses again as human review round `H+1`, with the new diff.
5. The phase line shows `fix pass 1/3 (human round 1)` in the terminal and web view.

There is no limit on human rounds. Fixer notes per comment, reviewer verdicts and resolve/reopen are later slices.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- Already built:
  - `src/runner/retry-hub.ts` — `ReviewChoice = { review: "apply"; force? } | { review: "drop" } | { review: "changes" }`, `waitReview()`, `decide(choice)`.
  - `src/review/phase.ts` — `case "human"`: calls `startHumanRound(...)`, emits `review:waiting`, awaits `opts.human.wait()`; on `changes` it currently logs `request changes is not available yet` and waits again (**replace this**). Saved state carries `humanRound` and `budgetBase` (via a `keep()` helper spread into every `save`).
  - `src/review/human.ts` — `Comment` (`id`, `round`, `file?`, `line?`, `snippet?`, `body`, `liveCheck`, `status: open|resolved|reopened`, `followUps: string[]`), `allComments(runDir, upToRound)`, `HumanReviewStore`.
  - `src/web/server.ts` — `/review` routes, `readJson`, 409 helper, server options `review` (hub) and `human: { runDir, repo }`.
- `src/review/phase.ts` review step end (131-141): exhaustion check `round >= config.fixPasses` and the save of `{ phase: "fix", round: round + 1, ..., fixBase }`; fix step (144-153): `const pass = progress.round; const reports = rounds[pass - 1]!; log(`... fix pass ${pass}/${config.fixPasses}`); opts.events?.emit("fix:start", { pass, passes: config.fixPasses });` then `fixPass(...)` (350-435, which calls `runFixer` with `{ round: pass, reports, specText, ... }`). Line 114 `showPhase(...)`.
- `src/agents/fixer.ts` — `FixerOptions` (18-48), `renderFinding` (64-70: `- **id** (severity, reviewer) \`file:line\`: description` + Failure scenario lines), `fixerPrompt(specText, reports, checks, validationFailure)` (76-132): intro (88-89), `## Specification` (91), `## Blocker and major findings (fix all of them)` (95), `## Minor findings` (99), `## Full reports` (103), `## Instructions` (106-115), validation failure (118-128), `COMMIT_INSTRUCTION` (130).
- `src/review/report.ts` — `Finding` type (`findingSchema` 10-20: `id`, `severity`, `file?`, `line?`, `description`, `failureScenario?`, `suggestedFix?`, `status`); `normalizeReport` (125-132) downgrades blockers without `failureScenario`.
- `src/runner/events.ts` — `PhaseChange` (7-13), `phaseLabel` (16-20); `fix:start { pass, passes }`.
- `src/ui/PhaseBar.tsx` `currentText()` (15-19): ``if (phase === "fix") return `${name} · fix pass ${round}/${fixPasses ?? "?"}`;``
- `src/web/page.html` `phaseLabel(p)` (160-165).
- Tests: `src/review/phase.test.ts` — `runReview` (53-95), `scripted` (627-631), events test (781-843) asserting labels like `"phase fix pass 1/3"`; `fixerCalls(provider)`; `provider.calls[i].prompt` for prompt asserts. Fake provider labels: `fixer:fix-r<N>`, `reviewer:code-r<N>`, `tester:tester-r<N>`.

## Patterns to follow

**Comment → finding** (add to `src/review/human.ts`):
```ts
export const openComments = (comments: readonly Comment[]): Comment[] => comments.filter((c) => c.status !== "resolved");
export const commentFindingId = (id: string): string => `human-${id}`;
/** A blocker per open comment; failureScenario is never empty, so normalizeReport never downgrades it. */
export function commentFindings(comments: readonly Comment[]): Finding[] // severity "blocker", status "open",
// description = [c.body, ...c.followUps].join("\n\nFollow-up: "), file/line copied,
// failureScenario = c.file ? `${c.file}${c.line ? `:${c.line}` : ""}\n${c.snippet ?? ""}`.trim() : "general comment on the whole change"
```

**Budget:** `budgetBase` = the review round right before the human pause. Exhausted when `round - progress.budgetBase >= config.fixPasses`; the displayed pass number is `pass - progress.budgetBase`. With no human rounds `budgetBase` is 0, so today's numbers don't change.

**Phase label:** `PhaseChange.humanRound?: number`; `phaseLabel({ phase: "fix", round, fixPasses, humanRound })` → `fix pass 1/3 (human round 1)` when `humanRound` is set. Same text in `PhaseBar` and `page.html`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/review/human.ts` (+ tests)
- **IMPLEMENT**: `openComments`, `commentFindingId`, `commentFindings`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/review/human.test.ts` — general vs line comment scenarios, follow-ups included, resolved excluded.

### UPDATE `src/agents/fixer.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `comments?: readonly Comment[]` in `FixerOptions`; pass it into `fixerPrompt` as a new optional last parameter. When non-empty, after `## Specification` insert:
  ```
  ## Human review comments (fix all of them)

  The user reviewed the result and asked for these changes. They come first.

  - **human-H1-1** `src/api/users.ts:18`: Paginate this, max 50 per page
    Code: ```...snippet...```
  ```
  and add an instruction bullet: "List, per comment id (human-H1-1, ...), what you changed in the commit message."
- **GOTCHA**: no comments → the prompt is byte-identical to today (there may be snapshot tests of the fixer prompt via phase tests).

### UPDATE `src/review/phase.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `case "human"` on `{ review: "changes" }`: `const open = openComments(await allComments(opts.runDir, progress.humanRound));` if empty, log and wait again; else emit `review:decided { decision: "changes" }`, `const fixBase = await revParse(...)`, save `{ phase: "fix", round: progress.round + 1, validationRounds: 0, reports: {}, fixBase, humanRound: progress.humanRound, budgetBase: progress.round }`.
  - Exhaustion checks (131, 136) → `round - progress.budgetBase >= config.fixPasses`; fix step: `const n = pass - progress.budgetBase` for the log, `fix:start { pass: n, passes }` and `showPhase({ phase: "fix", round: n, fixPasses, ...(progress.humanRound > 0 ? { humanRound: progress.humanRound } : {}) })`.
  - In `fixPass`, when `progress.humanRound > 0`, pass `comments: openComments(await allComments(opts.runDir, progress.humanRound))` to `runFixer`.
  - At the next pause the step goes to `human` with `humanRound + 1` (already implemented); `startHumanRound` uses the new head.
- **GOTCHA**: on resume in the middle of a human-triggered fix pass, `progress.budgetBase` and `humanRound` come from `state.json`, so the label and budget stay right.

### UPDATE `src/web/server.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `POST /review/changes` → 409 `{ error: "write or reopen a comment first" }` if `openComments(allComments(...))` is empty; else `review.decide({ review: "changes" })`.

### UPDATE `src/runner/events.ts`, `src/ui/PhaseBar.tsx`, `src/web/page.html`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `humanRound` in `PhaseChange` and both labels; a **Request changes** button in the review banner (enabled when at least one comment is open; shows the error box on 409).

### ADD tests (`src/review/phase.test.ts`, `src/web/server.test.ts`)
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - With `humanReview` on and a hub: wait → write a comment with `HumanReviewStore` → `decide({ review: "changes" })` → the next fixer call's prompt contains `## Human review comments` and `human-H1-1`; labels include `phase fix pass 1/3 (human round 1)`; the run pauses again with `humanRound === 2`; then apply → exit 0.
  - Fresh budget: `fixPasses: 1`, reviewer scripted with a blocker in every round → first loop exhausts, human changes → exactly one more fixer call before the second pause.
  - Three human rounds in a row work (no limit).
  - Server: `/review/changes` 409 with no open comment, 200 with one.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Request changes runs fixer → validate → review → test with a fresh `fixPasses` budget
- [ ] The fixer prompt lists every open comment first, as `human-<id>` blockers
- [ ] Phase line: `fix pass 1/3 (human round 1)` (terminal and web)
- [ ] The run pauses again afterwards, round `H+1`, with the new diff
- [ ] No limit on human rounds
- [ ] 409 when there is no open comment
- [ ] No human review → prompts and labels unchanged; `npm test` passes

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npx vitest run src/review src/agents src/web src/ui
npm run build && npx vitest run src/e2e.test.ts
```
